officialRef.pdf: 03 KET真题 - 第1套 - 参考答案&音频文稿.pdf

q1.explanationZh: 告示问“玩电脑游戏玩腻了吗？想找一个不同的爱好吗？”，然后邀请大家加入国际象棋社，说明社团想找愿意尝试新事物的人。A 错：告示没说要喜欢玩各种游戏；C 错：没有要求会下电脑象棋。

q2.explanationZh: Tilda 问 Zoe 有没有多余的 T 恤可以借给她上体育课，因为她忘带了，回家拿又来不及——她想知道 Zoe 能不能借她东西。B 错：她没有让 Zoe 去体育馆取东西；C 错：忘带运动服的是 Tilda 自己，不是 Zoe。

q3.explanationZh: 告示说“面包对鸭子不好”，并告诉大家游客中心有鸟食卖，意思是喂鸭子时要注意喂什么食物。A 错：只写了 1 英镑一袋，没有和别处比价格；B 错：告示不是鼓励更多人喂鸭子，而是提醒别喂面包。

q4.explanationZh: Wilson 老师听说 Josh 病了，说如果他下周不能参加大比赛，要尽快告诉她，也就是身体没好转就要联系她。A 错：她没说还没决定 Josh 能否参赛；B 错：比赛在下周，Josh 并没有错过，而且他现在还在生病。

q5.explanationZh: Eric 告诉妈妈 4 点的公交车晚点了，如果搭不到别人的车，他就走路回家——他在说自己打算怎么回家。A 错：他没有错过公交，是车晚点了；C 错：他没有问妈妈能不能开车来接他。

q6.explanationZh: 邮件说已经在名单上、但还没交钱的同学，请在下午 3 点前交 15 英镑，也就是有名额的人当天就要交钱。A 错：邮件没提还有空位；C 错：3 点是交钱的截止时间，不是开会时间。

q7.explanationZh: Frank 说他努力学习，只用了六个月就能把阿拉伯语说得、写得相当好，他对此非常高兴。B 错：Marc 只说自己学语言比较容易，没有说对进步的速度感到高兴。

evidence.quote: after just six months I was able to speak and write the language quite well, which I’m really happy about

q8.explanationZh: Marc 下载了一个泰语练习 app，每天早上自己用它学习，没有提到老师。A 错：Frank 有一位老师每周两次到他家上课；C 错：Ivan 在学院上课，有老师教。

evidence.quote: I’ve downloaded a new app with exercises in Thai

q9.explanationZh: Frank 学阿拉伯语是因为他将来想当记者，而会说其他语言对这份工作很重要。B 错：Marc 提到的 career 是他爸爸的工作，不是他自己想做的工作。

evidence.quote: I’m learning Arabic because I’d like to be a journalist one day

q10.explanationZh: Ivan 说老师总让大家笑，所以他从来不会忘记老师教的任何词汇。A 错：Frank 只说自己进步快，没说记得所有新单词。

evidence.quote: I never forget any of the vocabulary she teaches us

q11.explanationZh: Marc 回国后还在学泰语，这样就能继续和泰国同学聊天。C 错：Ivan 学俄语是为了和外公外婆交流，不是和朋友聊天。

evidence.quote: so I can continue to chat with my Thai classmates

q12.explanationZh: Ivan 的妈妈来自俄罗斯，外公外婆还住在那里，他学俄语是为了能和他们交流。B 错：Marc 虽然因为爸爸的工作搬过家，但他学泰语是为了和同学聊天。

evidence.quote: My mum comes from Russia and her parents still live there.

q13.explanationZh: Marc 因为爸爸的工作在很多国家生活过，所以学过好几种语言，而且学得很容易。A 错：Frank 刚开始学阿拉伯语时是完全的初学者。

evidence.quote: so I’ve had to learn several different languages

q14.explanationZh: Jelica 的父母是记者，有时在好莱坞工作，所以对这座城市非常熟悉，说明他们去过很多次。C 错：他们是记者，不是电影行业的人；B 错：文中没说他们不是每年都度假。

evidence.quote: My mum and dad are journalists and sometimes work there, so they know the city really well.

q15.explanationZh: 她们每天都沿着星光大道走，Jelica 说她很高兴，因为上面有太多名字可以读。A 错：文中只说它很受游客欢迎，没说太挤；C 错：只说酒店在它附近，没说从房间能看到。

evidence.quote: We walked along it every day, and I’m glad about that

q16.explanationZh: 她说游乐设施不错，但参观《侏罗纪公园》等电影的拍摄地才是她最喜欢的部分。A 错：rides 只是 good，不是最喜欢的；B 错：文中没说见到了明星。

evidence.quote: visiting the places where movies such as Jurassic Park were made was my favourite part of the tour

q17.explanationZh: 大多数房子离马路很远，或者藏在树和大门后面，所以很难看清。A 错：她说时间过得很快；B 错：导游非常有趣。

evidence.quote: most of the homes were a really long way from the road or behind trees or gates

q18.explanationZh: 她不敢相信还有 17,500 人也想看这部电影，没想到它这么受欢迎。A 错：《音乐之声》是爸爸最喜欢的电影，她早就很熟悉，并不意外；C 错：文中没说观众跟着唱歌。

evidence.quote: I couldn’t believe 17,500 other people wanted to watch it too

q19.explanationZh: move to + 地点表示“搬家到某地”：全家搬到了汉尼拔。left 后面不能接 to 表示去某地（应说 left for）；got to 是“到达”，不符合搬家的意思。

evidence.quote: to Hannibal, a town on the Mississippi River

q20.explanationZh: spend time doing sth 表示“花时间做某事”，后面正好是 chatting，所以用 spent。took 要用 it took sb time to do sth 的结构；used 不能这样接 doing。

evidence.quote: most of his free time chatting to the people who worked on the river

q21.explanationZh: tell stories（讲故事）是固定搭配。spoke 后面不能直接接 stories；said 后面接所说的话，也不能接 stories。

evidence.quote: He loved hearing the stories

q22.explanationZh: become a river boat captain 表示“成为一名河船船长”。start 和 begin 表示“开始”，后面不能接表示身份的名词。

evidence.quote: a river boat captain

q23.explanationZh: study hard 表示“努力学习”，他为了拿到执照而努力学习。long 不能这样修饰 study（要说 for a long time）；right 意思不通。

evidence.quote: for his licence and then worked for many years on the river

q24.explanationZh: most famous book 表示“最著名的书”。known 不说 most known，要说 best-known；excellent 本身就是“极好的”，一般不和 most 连用。

evidence.quote: came from his life on the Mississippi

q25.explanationZh: latest 是最高级形式，前面要用定冠词 the：the latest computer game“最新的电脑游戏”。

evidence.quote: latest computer game that I’ve tried

q26.explanationZh: 空格处是句子的主语，指代前面提到的游戏 MathsFun，所以填 It 或 This。

evidence.quote: is very easy to play and includes exercises and quizzes

q27.explanationZh: There are + 复数名词表示“有……”：There are two reasons“有两个原因”。

evidence.quote: are two reasons why I like this computer game

q28.explanationZh: play with friends 表示“和朋友一起玩”（也可以 play against friends“和朋友对战”），与前面的 play alone（独自玩）相对。

evidence.quote: I can choose to play alone

q29.explanationZh: a month ago / a month back 表示“一个月以前”，与后面的过去进行时 wasn't getting 相呼应。

evidence.quote: I wasn’t getting good marks at school, but now I am

q30.explanationZh: If 引导条件状语从句：If you want to improve too“如果你也想进步”，你就应该试试这个游戏。

evidence.quote: you want to improve too, you should try this game

q31.sampleAnswer:
Jay,
There is a new movie in the cinema called “Attack Crocodiles” and I found out that this Saturday they are putting it in the cinema at 5.30pm. Would you like to come with me?
You will like it very much because I know you love crocodiles and action movies.
You tell me ...

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：邀请 Jay 和你一起去看电影；推荐一部要看的电影；说明 Jay 为什么会喜欢这部电影
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response:
Jay,
There is a new movie in the cinema called “Attack Crocodiles” and I found out that this Saturday they are putting it in the cinema at 5.30pm. Would you like to come with me?
You will like it very much because I know you love crocodiles and action movies.
You tell me ...
anchors.noteZh: 三个要点都写得很清楚，读者能完全了解信息；组织得很好，衔接清楚（and, because）；词汇贴合任务，有些超出本级别（found out, action movies）；多种语法结构使用得当且基本准确（There is, Would you like to, You will like it, I know you love）。内容5/条理性5/语言5。

anchors.response:
Hi Jay
What do you will do tomorrow? Do you want to go to the cinema with me? Then I am thinking of watching a horror film. You can enjoy eating that food you want.
anchors.noteZh: 三个要点都写到了，但第三点不够清楚：说的是为什么会喜欢去电影院，而不是为什么会喜欢这部电影；行文有逻辑，但只用了一个连接词，而且用错了（Then I am thinking of watching a horror film.）；语法结构简单且有错误（What do you will do tomorrow, that food you want），但意思仍能看懂。内容4/条理性3/语言3。

q31.explanationZh: 满分邮件要写清三点：邀请 Jay 周六一起去看电影、推荐一部具体的电影、说明 Jay 为什么会喜欢这部电影（而不只是喜欢去电影院），并用 and、because 等连接词把句子连起来。

q32.sampleAnswer: When a boy was in the park, he made a friend and they both started to play with a ball, but it got stuck in a big tree. One of the boys climbed the tree to get the ball, so they could go back to playing.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：两人在公园里踢球；球飞到树上卡住了；男孩爬上树把球拿下来
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response: When a boy was in the park, he made a friend and they both started to play with a ball, but it got stuck in a big tree. One of the boys climbed the tree to get the ball, so they could go back to playing.
anchors.noteZh: 三幅图都写到了，读者能完全了解故事；用多种连接词和指代词组织文章（When, he, and, but, One of, so），词汇丰富（made a friend, it got stuck, climbed, go back to）；第一句可能太长，最好分成两句，但整体读起来很顺，而且没有错误。内容5/条理性5/语言5。

anchors.response: There are two people, a man and a woman. They were playing with a ball, but the ball fell on the tree. The man climbed the tree and he take the ball. Later they continued playing with ball.
anchors.noteZh: 三幅图都写进了故事，但结尾与第三幅图不完全一致——图中看不到他们继续玩；衔接方式简单但恰当（They, but, and, Later）；有一些相关词汇（playing with a ball, climbed, take），语法结构较丰富且大多准确（They were playing, The man climbed, they continued playing）；有少量小语法错误（he take, playing with ball），但意思仍清楚。内容4/条理性3/语言4。

q32.explanationZh: 满分故事要把三幅图都写到：两人在公园踢球、球卡在树上、男孩爬树把球拿下来，并用 when、but、so 等连接词把情节连贯地串起来。
